## 📌 Description
Establish a clean Page Object Model (POM) with `BasePage`, reusable UI actions, and standardised locator strategies.

## ✅ Tasks
- [ ] **BasePage.java**
- Hold `Page` reference from Playwright
- Common methods: `click`, `fill`, `waitForSelector`, `getText`, `isVisible`
- Retry logic using Playwright’s built‑in locator assertions (no manual sleeps)

- [ ] **Sample Page Object**
- `TodoMvcPage.java` – locators and actions for the demo todomvc app
- Methods: `addTodo(text)`, `getTodoItems()`, `toggleComplete(index)`

- [ ] **Test Refactoring**
- Rewrite `TC_001` to use `TodoMvcPage` instead of raw Playwright code
- Add second test `TC_002` for item completion and filtering

- [ ] **Locator Strategy**
- Use `data-testid` where possible, otherwise CSS/role selectors
- Store locators as `private final Locator` fields inside page classes

- [ ] **Custom Exception Handling**
- `FrameworkException.java` (unchecked) – wraps Playwright and assertion errors

## 🔍 Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Tests become more readable and maintainable (no Playwright API calls inside test methods)
- [ ] `BasePage` methods log each action using Log4j2
- [ ] All existing tests pass after refactoring

## 📎 Dependencies
- [ ] v0.2.0 (configuration, logging) must be complete

## 🧪 Validation
- [ ] Run `mvn test` – verify both `TC_001` and `TC_002` pass
- [ ] Check logs contain page action entries (e.g., “Clicking on add button”)
- [ ] Code passes Checkstyle rules (naming, line length)
